svg.title: Soldering diagram
svg.desc: Pictorial wiring of an Arduino Nano to a TM1637 display, a START button and a relay module with eleven numbered, colour-coded wires and two splices.
svg.text: Eleven wires and two splices. No custom board: the Arduino itself carries everything.
An Uno R3 has the same pins:
COM and NO go to the 12 V circuit (see schematic)
A: 5V splice joins wires 3, 4 and 5. B: GND splice joins wires 6, 7, 8 and 9.
Header order differs between modules, read the silkscreen.
